data.evidence_sentence: Student type: Domestic and international students
data.notes: Page lists fee offset and stipend variants; award described is the Graduate Research Scholarships at University of Melbourne. No application deadline stated. Selection based on academic results and research potential (not a fixed minimum GPA). Eligibility: applied for and meet requirements for a graduate research degree at the University of Melbourne, or currently enrolled in one. Study area list is broad but not explicitly ANY; field set to ANY as no restriction is stated beyond the list. Funding types: full fee offset plus living allowance for stipend scholarships (full); fee offset only is partial. Page mentions 'Masters by Research' and 'doctoral degree (PhD)'. Some text is outdated (2027 rate) but no deadline present.
